# Chapter 22 — Decomposition & Covering

## Cover Families
- condensation DAG cover
- BFS forest cover

## APIs
- `condensation_dag_cover(g[, options])`
- `validate_condensation_dag_cover(...)`
- `bfs_forest_cover(g[, options])`
- `validate_bfs_forest_cover(...)`
- `score_cover(...)`

## Goals
- minimize piece count
- balance piece sizes
- maximize locality
